name: Teenage Dirtbag
source: The story centers around a group of California high school students through the perspective of Miles, an antisocial and mentally ill boy whose only bright spot in life is his crush, Michael.
translation: 故事以Miles的视角，讲述一群加州高中生的生活。Miles是个反社会、患有精神疾病的男孩，而他生命中唯一的亮色，就是暗恋着Michael。
